The peaks found on the noisy disks image of the figure, with the default settings. The wave has the frequency (0.1, 0.05), a period of 8.94 pixels. On this 160 x 160 image the wave lies exactly on the grid of the FFT, in steps of 1 / 160 = 0.00625, so the peak is found at the wave frequency itself. Other waves give the grid frequency next to them. The peak gets a Gaussian notch at its mirror points too.
